Ravi: Idea 1: Launch a "Marketplace Spotlight" mini-series: 3x20-min webinars (integration + customer story + benchmark walk-through), short blog post each week, gated one-pager benchmark. Goal: MQLs + validation for partner listing.
Tara: Nice. Can we sequence content so the first webinar is product/light demo, second is customer case, third is deep-dive benchmark? helps funnel ppl deeper.
Lena: Messaging test suggestion: A) "Speed & predictability" (dev-focused) vs B) "Lower inference $/req" (finance/ops). We'll run two landing variants and 2 subject lines.
Omar: For inbound tracking: please standardize utm_source=marketplace&utm_medium=partner&utm_campaign=spotlight_may. CRM rule to assign:
```
when lead.source == 'marketplace' and utm_campaign == 'spotlight_may':
  owner = 'marketplace-queue'
  add_tag('co-marketing','spotlight')
  set_stage('marketing-qualified')
```
Keisha: I'll draft three headline options for the blog: 1) "Marketplace Spotlight: Redwood + CloudVendor in 20 minutes" 2) "How [Customer] cut inference costs and kept latency low" 3) "Build predictable, low-cost inference with Redwood" which direction?
Ravi: #2 is best for social proof; but keep a shorter headline for demo landing. Put #1 on the event page.
Tara: Logistics: Dates? aiming for Tuesday evenings (EMEA-friendly). Proposed: 2026-05-19, 2026-05-26, 2026-06-02. Thoughts?
Lena: Test cadence good. Need to lock partner speaker availability. Also create a short eval checklist for the benchmark so it's reproducible: dataset, model size, seq len, batch config, infra cost assumptions.
Omar: I'll open the HubSpot mapping PR: https://hub.company/PR-4821 and add webhooks to notify #sales-marketplace channel on new lead. fallback: if marketplace-queue > 10 open leads, rotate to SDR-pool.
Keisha: Social copy draft for the first promo: "Join our 20-min Marketplace Spotlight with CloudVendor + Redwood. See a live integration, customer story, and a quick benchmark. Register now." Any edits?
Ravi: Good. Add CTA "Download benchmark one-pager" after the webinar.
crm-bot: Reminder set: publish first post draft 2026-05-12 09:00 UTC, webinar 1 on 2026-05-19 18:00 UTC.
Tara: Action items: Keisha 1 write blog + email copy; Omar 1 HubSpot mapping + webhook; Lena 1 benchmark checklist + A/B landing setup; Ravi 1 runbook + partner coordination. Sync Friday 10am for go/no-go. :rocket:
